description: Potential for magmatic uranium systems in Australia Map 1: Intrusive-related is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. Intrusive-related U mineralisation constitutes only a small proportion of Australia's known U resources despite the widespread occurrence of U-rich intrusive igneous rocks across both time and space. Due to this apparent discrepancy, the potential for intrusive-related U systems has been assessed on a continental scale using a GIS-based approach. Coverage: Australia. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read).
